subject: 云冈第20窟 · 主尊坐像
author: Patrick20242023
source_note: 2024年第20窟正面实拍；选中央大佛而非完整龛组，不复原残损手指。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One fine contour heritage drawing for 访古. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: delicate sparse slightly organic black outlines, empty white planes, elegant restrained details. Image 2 is GEOMETRY ONLY: the principal seated Shakyamuni Buddha of Yungang Grottoes Cave 20, Northern Wei. Draw ONLY this central monumental seated Buddha, complete head, broad shoulders, draped torso, weathered joined hands/lap and broad knees. Preserve its real round smooth high ushnisha (NOT Vairocana curls), calm broad facial shape, protruding ears, asymmetrical robe leaving the right upper chest bare, repeated curved robe folds on its left shoulder, and actual damaged broken areas around the forearms and lap. Do NOT copy image 1's face or costume. Do NOT restore missing fingers or eroded feet. Show just a few quiet broken rock contours at its base; OMIT the neighboring standing Buddha and the detailed rock wall, little seated figures and flaming mandorla. Portrait 1024x1536, front-facing with very slight real low view, complete selected statue uncut and centered inside generous white margins, occupying about 78% height. Fine BLACK lines on pure WHITE, white interiors, no shading, no solid black areas, no hatching, no textures or stippling, no color, no text, no border. Let major contours and about a dozen selective garment folds convey the statue. Keep airy line density and line weight close to the style master.

site_recommendation.name: 云冈石窟
site_recommendation.era: 北魏 · 昙曜五窟时期
site_recommendation.yearNote: 以第20窟所属昙曜五窟约460—470年的营造阶段定位，465只用于排序。
site_recommendation.lede: 第20窟前壁坍失后，主尊从洞窟中显露出来。宽肩、圆润面容与袒露右胸的袈裟，保留了北魏早期大像的庄重体量。
facts: 第16至20窟通称昙曜五窟，是云冈最早的一组大窟。
本图只取第20窟中央释迦牟尼坐像，保留臂部与膝前的实际残损。
圆顶肉髻、长耳和不对称披衣是辨识主像的线索；两旁立像及龛壁未绘入。
